items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: But Dan Grissom was really the true vocalist with the group, you know.

ctx.x: Sy Oliver and Eddie Tompkins. Yeah, see, when I -- they were the trio all the time before I went in the band. Of course, Dan Grissom was the vocalist. And out of us four guys I don't think any of us could really sing. But we had styles -- a little style going and it really helped. But Dan Grissom was really the true vocalist with the group, you know. And he had a -- he sang very high -- he had a high pitch voice back in those days. But he had -- he sang most of
the ballads and things of that sort. All we did was the jump tunes and things like that, you know.
